notes: Independent blind reproduction from paper text only; no author scripts or output files opened. Data: cleaned_commitment_study_data.dta (participant level). Attempts 1-2 were exploratory (variable listing; coding of flags and contract choice variables; q169/q295 coded 2 = chose the 'more' contract, chose_commit12 coded 1 = chose). Sample: drop the 44 endogenous-assignment participants (flag_exclude_exog==1 or flag_low_wtp==1) and the 122 remaining wave-3 participants assigned the $80-for-12-visits contract -> 1126 participants. BCP (conservative): per participant, mean over the pairs $1-2, $2-3, $3-5, $5-7, $7-12 of (WTP increase / incentive increase) minus the average of the forecasted attendance (days_k) at the two incentives; WTP variables already include fill-in-the-blank amounts. Goal gap = goal - days_0; actual gap = visits - days_{assigned incentive}; both (and BCP for Table 4) z-scored over the 1126-participant sample (sample SD). Table 3: OLS with wave FE, HC1 robust SEs; Table 4: stacked participant x threshold LPM (8/12/16 in waves 1-2, 12 in wave 3; 2824 obs) with wave and threshold FE, SEs clustered by participant. flag_confusion was not used as an exclusion (paper does not mention it for these tables).
